summary: NextNRG filed an 8-K disclosing a September 30, 2026 amendment to its August 13, 2026 securities purchase agreement with an institutional buyer covering up to 3,000,000 shares of Series C Convertible Non-Voting Preferred for an aggregate $27.2 million, of which 1,000,000 shares ($9.2 million) closed initially. The amendment aligns the certificate of designation with the planned Delaware-to-Nevada redomestication and tightens conditions for additional mandatory closings, requiring VWAP above both 200% of the Floor Price and the then-highest conversion price, plus no continuing redemption or trigger event; stockholder approval for all conversion shares is also required. This is an ordinary preferred financing amendment, not a special situation.
